segments.name: Foundry Services
segments.description: Specialty foundry providing high-value, high-quality processed wafers to customers for diverse end markets using advanced process technologies.
segments.evidence: We are a pure-play independent specialty foundry, and as such we are dedicated to providing high-value, high-quality, processed wafers to our customers for their end products and end users.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for wafer foundry services based on their design specifications and process technology requirements across multiple end markets.
revenueModel.evidence: Our foundry processes use chemical materials, chemical processes and other materials and equipment on silicon wafers, based on the design specifications of our customers.
